nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf tracking token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used for spending approvals and decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private owner address set in the constructor to msg.sender; gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Private mapping _onSaleNum[address=>uint] counting per-address sales; incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private mapping canSale[address=>bool] whitelist bypassing the sale-condition check in ensure.
Private _minSale lower bound for a sale, set by init and enforced in condition.
Private _maxSale upper bound for a sale, set by init and enforced in condition.
Private _saleNum maximum number of sales per address, set by init and enforced in condition.
Address tradeAddress whitelisted in ensure and settable only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Constant UNI router address 0x7a250d...488D auto-approved in the constructor.
Public totalSupply set once in the constructor.
Public payable transfer(address _to,uint _value) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom performing unchecked allowance and balance mutations plus the ensure() whitelist check.
Internal view whitelist gate comparing _from/_to against owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and the computed pair.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits on a transfer.
Public payable approve(address _spender,uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Public payable delegate(address a,bytes b) executing an arbitrary delegatecall when msg.sender == owner.
Owner-only init() configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from scaled inputs.
Owner-only batchSend() distributing _value to every address in _tos with unchecked balance arithmetic and inconsistent Transfer events.
Owner-only setTradeAddress(address addr) updating the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure pairFor() computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of factory, token hashes and init code hash.
Payable constructor minting the full supply to the deployer, setting owner and pre-approving the UNI router.
Untrusted msg.sender used for ownership gating, allowances, approvals and transfers.
a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary external code in the contract storage context.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtraction without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value loop arithmetic in batchSend.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value mutations in transferFrom.
Parameter _to of transfer(), the destination address.
Parameter _value, the amount moved and checked against min/max sale bounds.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(), the debited account validated by ensure().
Parameter _spender of approve(), the approved spender address.
Parameter a of delegate(), the arbitrary delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate(), the arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
Parameter saleNum of init(), the per-address sale cap.
Parameter token of init(), the minimum sale amount before decimal scaling.
Parameter maxToken of init(), the maximum sale amount before decimal scaling.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(), the recipient array driving the transfer loop.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(), the new whitelisted trade address.
Local _UNI in ensure() holding the computed Uniswap pair address used for whitelisting.
Local _to inside the batchSend loop, the current recipient.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender argument in transfer().
msg.sender determines which allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom().
msg.sender is the owner key written into the allowance mapping by approve().
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
The owner-supplied address a is the arbitrary delegatecall target, allowing full storage takeover.
Caller-supplied bytes b is the calldata executed by the delegatecall.
delegate() performs an external delegatecall that executes untrusted code in this contract's storage, enabling reentrant state manipulation.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked allowance subtraction without SafeMath.
_value flows into the unchecked allowance decrement.
transferFrom() mutates balances with raw += / -= operators.
balanceOf mapping entries are read and rewritten without overflow protection.
batchSend() subtracts the total and adds _value per recipient with unchecked arithmetic.
The user-supplied recipient array size drives total = _value * _tos.length and the unchecked balance updates.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() to validate sender and recipient.
ensure() falls back to condition() when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address via pairFor().
ensure() reads the canSale whitelist mapping.
ensure() compares _from against the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner address.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
The locally computed pair address _UNI is used in the ensure() whitelist comparison.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale cap.
condition() reads _saleNum when bounding sales.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the lower bound.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the upper bound.
The _from parameter is the account validated by ensure().
_value is bounded against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition().
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a sale.
approve() writes the allowance mapping.
The _spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve().
init() writes _minSale from the scaled token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the scaled maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum.
saleNum parameter is stored as the sale cap by init().
token parameter is scaled by 10**decimals into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled by 10**decimals into _maxSale.
batchSend() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for the sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress() overwrites the tradeAddress state variable.
The addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress.
The _to parameter is passed through transfer() to transferFrom().
The _value parameter is forwarded by transfer() to transferFrom().
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing all owner-only privileges.
The constructor mints the entire supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor sets totalSupply from _supply scaled by 10**decimals.
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the constant UNI router address.
The loop-local recipient _to is credited inside batchSend().

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a parameter of transfer() and is forwarded to transferFrom().
_value is the amount processed by transferFrom() and its unchecked allowance decrement.
_from is the debited account handled directly by transferFrom().
_spender is only used to index the allowance mapping written by approve().
Parameter a is exactly the untrusted delegatecall target inside delegate().
Parameter b is exactly the calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
saleNum has no role outside init() where it configures _saleNum.
token is only consumed by init() when computing _minSale.
maxToken is only consumed by init() when computing _maxSale.
The _tos array drives the unchecked arithmetic loop in batchSend().
addr is only stored into the tradeAddress state variable by setTradeAddress().
The local pair address is computed and consumed only within ensure().
The loop-local recipient exists only inside batchSend().
